title: Rosa the caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
lines: On a green leaf, in a big garden, lay a tiny white egg.
It lay there very still in the sun.
Out crawled a tiny little caterpillar.
She was green, with little pink spots.
She nibbled the leaf she was sitting on.
So she crawled to the next leaf.
One day Rosa met a ladybird.
It was red with black spots.
Hello, little caterpillar, said the ladybird.
Eating, said Rosa with her mouth full.
I have to get big and strong.
She ate leaves from the apple tree.
She ate leaves from the rose bush.
She ate a bit of lettuce from the gardener's vegetable patch.
She got longer, and fatter, and stronger.
The snail carried his house on his back, and he was very slow.
Rosa, said the snail, you've got very fat!
That's right, laughed Rosa, and I'm very tired.
One day Rosa felt something strange.
She didn't want to eat anymore.
To sleep for a very long time.
She crawled onto a little twig.
She hung herself upside down, and she spun a soft, brown little house around herself.
The ladybird and the snail came to look.
They only saw a brown parcel on a twig.
Then, one sunny morning, the brown parcel moved.
A little crack appeared in it.
The wings slowly opened in the sun.
They were pink and orange, with yellow spots, and they sparkled.
Now I know why I had to eat so much!
Rosa spread her wings, and she flew up, over the garden, over the flowers.
She drank sweet nectar from a rose.
And every day she came to say hello to her friends, the ladybird and the snail.
